outcome: Conversion rate from epidural analgesia to cesarean section anesthesia
Type of anesthesia used for cesarean section (EA, GA, SA)
cohort: Parturients who received epidural labor analgesia but required subsequent regional or general anesthesia for cesarean section at 'Sveti Duh' University Hospital Zagreb between January 1, 2021 and December 31, 2021
finding: The study found a significantly higher rate of conversion from epidural analgesia to general anesthesia for cesarean section than desired, highlighting the need for improved organization and implementation of best clinical practice protocols in obstetric anesthesiology.
mod_finding: The study aimed to determine the conversion rate from epidural analgesia to cesarean section anesthesia to enhance the quality of anesthetic care for obstetric patients.
